verdict.rationale: macOS documents built-in password management through its Passwords app, which flags weak or compromised passwords and can update them, and its help guide covers recovering deleted passwords and passkeys. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of creating, editing and syncing passkeys; independent or hands-on corroboration of the Passwords app.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can manage passwords and passkeys using a built-in privacy and security tool

citations.quote: Your Mac includes built-in tools to protect your important information—from password management to private browsing and beyond.
The Passwords app alerts you to weak or compromised passwords and can update them on your behalf without the hassle.
Learn how to recover a deleted password or passkey.
